title: Cuekeeper manifest v1 · video artifact
description: Optional session video written by a replay run. Sits on manifest.video, next to files and assets. report.json is not extended: video is an artifact, never a pass/fail input. See docs/session-video.md.

kind.description: Discriminator so a reader can tell video from filmstrip when both are present.

status.description: complete: finalized and playable. truncated: capture ended early, file is still playable up to truncatedAtMs. skipped: nothing was written, code says why.

code.description: Present when status is truncated or skipped. Closed enum: no free-text reasons.

path.description: Archive-relative path of the movie. Must also appear in files[] with its byte length and SHA-256.

durationMs.description: Movie duration. Equals the stop time, not the last sample time: the last frame is held until capture stops.

frames.description: Number of encoded samples. Far below durationMs / frameInterval when the window was idle.

timebase.description: Track timing. PTS are only comparable in this timescale, so it is recorded instead of assumed.

timescale.description: Track timescale used by the container (VideoToolbox chose 600 in the spike).

firstPtsMs.description: Presentation time of the first sample, which is 0 for every run that keeps its first captured frame.

anchor.description: Mapping from report-relative time to video PTS: videoPtsMs = entry.atMs - videoStartOffsetMs.

reportStartedAt.description: Copy of report.startedAt, so an artifact moved out of its package still anchors correctly.

videoStartOffsetMs.description: reportAtMs of video PTS 0. Negative when capture started before the run was recorded as started.

method.description: host_clock: both sides derive from CMClockGetHostTimeClock, so an NTP jump cannot desync the movie.

sampling.description: Thresholds actually used, so a surprising result can be reproduced or argued about.

blockThreshold.description: Per-cell max luma delta that counts as a changed cell.

structuralBlocks.description: Changed-cell count that upgrades a frame from churn to structural.

gaps.description: Intervals with no sample. Capped: a reader must not depend on a complete list, and the viewer falls back to report atMs gaps.

truncatedAtMs.description: Report-relative time where capture stopped early. Required when status is truncated.

pausedMs.description: Total time spent paused by the operator; the movie keeps the last frame, so it is not subtracted from durationMs.

maskedRegions.description: Rectangles blacked out before encoding, in captured pixel coordinates. Bounded so a manifest stays small.
